source: SP 20.13330.2016: the first limit state group (strength, stability) as SAEngine's strength combinations with the design values γf × the normative ones: permanent 1.1 on D with the superimposed dead load (RC; steel 1.05, factory-made layers 1.2 and site-made layers 1.3 not told apart: SAEngine's combinations have one factor on D, U), floor live 1.3 (1.2 at 2.0 kN/m² and more: 1.3 taken, on the safe side, P), snow 1.4, wind 1.4; the basic combinations with ψt 1.0, 0.9, 0.7 for the first, second and third short-term loads (6.3); the special combination with the earthquake of SP 14.13330.2018 Table 2 (0.9 permanent, 0.5 short-term; wind not combined). The second limit state group (serviceability) as the service combinations with the normative values (γf 1). The snow load is case Lr (enveloped with the roof live load).
